gaps.text:
CORE GAPS — drawn here, not in core yet (mirror of docs/web/CORE-GAPS.md · audited 2026-10-11 at main@b2b4473, re-audited 2026-10-16 at main@b3d75c9)
✓ landed on main · partly: what is missing — what exists · Default access "legacy": operator data, band-plan writes protected only.

Owner to decide first
✓ Categories: 8 + other, entity key, position
✓ Device names: name, kind, last seen (hour)
• Labels for talkgroups, radio IDs, capcodes, MMSIs

Spectrum
✓ FFT stream (0.5–25 Hz, ≤2048 bins) · ✓ Waterfall backfill (≤10 s)
• Zoom (real FFT of viewed slice)
partly: FFT size up to 16384 — averaging 1–32
• Tuner control over WS (drag-to-pan)

Band plans and presets
✓ Scan presets: built-in per region + operator CRUD
partly: Layered plans — stack, region packs, SDR++ import, edits; country packs, SDR#/Gqrx/URL open
partly: Station country — config/env, /api/station; not from location or UI
partly: Shared model — model has groups, channels, hints; built-ins ship none; registry FRS only
partly: Built-in fixes — airband 8.33, PMR446, CB, 169 MHz, ISM combo; 466 pagers, TETRA skip open
partly: Store details — order, edits, reset, preview; "Check for update", decoder link open
partly: Plans feed scanner — stack, hidden; skip, imports, decoder channels open
• Follow hits

Tuner
partly: Capabilities — /api/receiver-capabilities; gains, rates, range open
• DC removal, IQ correction, IQ swap

Audio
✓ live-audio:level at 10 Hz
• One WS audio stream, 48 kHz, latency
partly: Noise squelch — manual/auto + margin, no restart
• AGC modes, NR, NB, notch, BFO, DSB

Analog transmissions
✓ Transmission events · ✓ DTMF on closed events
• Analog vs digital per transmission
partly: DCS, live tone, tone squelch — CTCSS on closed events
• Recording id on the event

Activity and events
✓ Envelope, live and stored · ✓ Rate history per decoder
partly: Event store — SQLite/FTS5, filters, paging; audio, kept, tone filters open
partly: Facets "With audio" — category/protocol/decoder/source/kind
partly: Digital metadata — colour code, NAC, RAN, algorithm; alias, error rate open
partly: Auto band map — occupancy only

Event contract
✓ scanner:progress at 2 Hz
partly: Scanner replay — Activity cursor replay with reset reasons

Access
✓ Bootstrap · ✓ Devices list · ✓ Device name/kind/last seen
partly: Browser end to end — server batch 1, Caddy TLS; client, live TLS, default open
• Read-only role

Scanner (S1 on main)
✓ Identity search · ✓ Signals only · ✓ Running range edits · ✓ Ignore skips sweeps
✓ preemptedBy · ✓ Decoder IDs in impact · ✓ Per-hop protocols
partly: Auto-resume — resumeAt, audio/identify holds, Stay here; recording hold open
partly: Per-range exclusions — name, dwell, sensitivity done
partly: Hit stats lastDurationMs — /jobs/:id/hits, firstSeenInJob
• decodedElsewhere in plan preview
• ScannerProtocol ais/acars/vdl2/lora
• Passive protocols per source · discoveryId on saved frequencies
• S2 enabled, S3 listen-scan

Recordings
• Auto-record all, playback with seek
• Recording state on every event
• Keep (star) · manual recordings with trim
• Operator IQ capture + playback
• Waveform peaks, IQ thumbnails
partly: GET /api/storage — scanner caps, Activity retention
• Stable /api/recordings/:id + download · transcripts (future)

Map
✓ Vessels, APRS, mesh state · ✓ Mesh links SNR · ✓ Coverage per bearing 24 h
• Position history and timeline
• PMTiles extract, OpenFreeMap fallback
partly: ACARS/VDL2 positions — AIS type 21 aids tracked
• Route, military flag

Settings and station
✓ Decoder log
partly: Station identity — config, /api/station, readsb; UI, estimate, other decoders open
• Settings store with provenance
partly: Synced operator settings — 4 prefs + some usage
• One settings schema · runtime decoder options (PATCH 501)
• Language, log level, map labels, audio format
• sdr-host version · config export/import

New in core, not drawn
• Activity retention per share, floodCopies
• Activity reset reasons, holes, closed
• Reception provenance: source, frequency, tuning trust
• Mesh telemetry (battery, voltage, airtime), duplicate copies
• Coverage layer + "no station location"
• APRS weather, path, objects/items · vessel class, voyage, navStatus
• 2 s per-entity update throttle
• Band-plan 428/409 conflicts, preset issues, orphaned edits, segments
• Unknown states (registry, receiver capabilities)
• Lost-browser revoke via machine credential
